_note: NYAYA rule base. Rejection-reason -> evidence-that-answers-it, and which SAAKSHYA band produces it. Declarative so FRA amendments are config, not code (PRD 7.1 / D5).

no_pre_2005_proof.label: No proof of occupation before 13-Dec-2005
no_pre_2005_proof.answered_by_evidence: Dated land-use conversion before 2005 + decade image strip

notes_by_category.ST: KAAL can PROVE occupation before the 2005 cutoff (inside the 1972 Landsat archive).
notes_by_category.OTFD: KAAL STRENGTHENS continuity but CANNOT prove the ~75-year (pre-1930) bar (beyond any satellite). Disclose.

boundary_dispute.label: Boundary / overlap dispute
boundary_dispute.answered_by_evidence: Segmented parcel + PostGIS topology conflict map

gram_sabha_procedure.label: Gram Sabha procedural defect
gram_sabha_procedure.answered_by_evidence: Corrected resolution / re-filing checklist (workflow, not imagery)

non_st_otfd.label: Eligibility (not ST/OTFD)
non_st_otfd.answered_by_evidence: Community / caste records (out of scope for imagery)

legal_basis: Rule 13, Forest Rights Rules (amended 06-09-2012): satellite imagery is admissible as ONE of the listed evidences, may SUPPLEMENT not REPLACE; any two evidences. Rule 12A(11): SDLC/DLC cannot insist on a particular evidence. (Gujarat HC 2013, Van Kanun Bachau Samiti.)
